Allotrope Medical is a Houston-based medical device company.

Allotrope Medical’s first device, the StimSite, is an intuitive hand-held device that assists surgeons in quickly and easily identifying ureters during a surgical procedure.

aiResearchSummary.text: Allotrope Medical is engaged in research and development of a system and method to evoke smooth muscle response during surgery, as described in the title and abstract of a device intended for use with electrosurgical units. This smooth muscle stimulation device is designed to help identify and localize non-target tissues, such as ureters, during tissue resection and other surgical procedures, supporting safer surgical outcomes. Their focus centers on intraoperative tissue identification and localization.
